basics.name: Emanuel Betancur Villamil
basics.label: Mechatronics, Automation & Manufacturing Systems Engineer
basics.summary:
Bilingual (English/Spanish) Mechatronics Engineer (B.S.) with an Associate of Science in Computer Science and 6+ years of hands-on experience spanning industrial automation, controls diagnostics, plant utilities reliability, optical/laser systems, and software/CMMS integration. Bridges office-level planning and programming (Python, C#, SQL, CAD) with factory-floor execution, commissioning, and team training—delivering measurable ROI across uptime, energy efficiency, and product documentation.

• US Permanent Resident (Authorized to work without sponsorship)

work.name: United Window & Door Mfg., Inc.
work.summary: Promoted to lead systems integration, plant utilities stabilization, and maintenance modernization across Springfield and Wayne, NJ facilities.
highlights: Primary on-site systems engineer supporting automated Erdman/Billco insulated glass lines (Allen-Bradley/Rockwell PLCs & FactoryTalk HMIs), stabilizing KineticoPRO RO water, Grundfos SCALA1 pumping, and 90-95 PSI Argon utilities.

Developed an empirical compressed air energy audit across 3 plants (110-130 PSI across 45-110 kW compressors), quantifying 88-264 CFM losses per site and identifying $18,200-$24,200+/year in energy savings.

Architected and piloted an in-house bilingual CMMS ('United Maintenance Way') in Building 21 integrated with Fenevision ERP, QR-code downtime tracking, 5 Whys RCA, and shop-floor Poka-Yoke web tools (Low-E visualizer, 5S rack labels).
Audited 14 industrial electrical control cabinets in Building 21 and trained peer engineers in Wayne to standardize inspections, bilingual SOPs, and optical light-curtain compliance.

work.name: United Window & Door Mfg., Inc.
work.summary: Led critical machine recovery, motion control troubleshooting, CNC metrology calibration, and process reliability initiatives in Springfield, NJ.
highlights: Diagnosed and replaced a failing TRIO MC206 motion controller (Motion Perfect 2), eliminating 2-4 weekly stops and achieving 0 hours of unplanned downtime for 30+ consecutive days.

Restored an automated Urban 4590 saw after 5 years of inactivity, integrating B&R firewall/Fenevision ERP cut-list streaming (18 units/shift) and unattended Power Automate RPA file archiving (120-file buffer).

Calibrated Siemens Sinumerik 828D CNC machining centers (< 1/16" tolerance), re-engineered Zebra ZPL II labels, benchmarked PVC ESD mitigation (Simco-Ion/Keyence/Silvent), and led a PTFE tape study (+166% lifespan, -51% shift cost).

work.name: Beta Machine Solutions LLC
work.summary: Field and design engineering for medical-aesthetic laser platforms and commercial AMR deployments (continuing part-time consulting from Oct 2025-Present).
highlights: Conducted component-level electrical, optical spectra, high-power supply, and hydraulic/Peltier-TEC thermal diagnostics on medical-aesthetic laser platforms (Diode 810nm/755nm, Nd:YAG, Er:YAG, CO2, IPL, RF, HIFU) across NJ, NY, FL, and MI.
Engineered CAD mechanical adaptations and hardware modifications to meet US compliance and reliability requirements for Luna Medical Technology, Supramedical, and Medexx.
Executed 2 commercial warehouse deployment contracts for Pudu Robotics industrial autonomous cleaning robots (AMRs), managing commissioning, sensor calibration, and fluid-system maintenance.

work.name: Cambridge Pavingstones with ArmorTec
work.summary: 3-month engineering contract automating product texture capture/color pipelines and co-authoring official customer assembly documentation.
highlights: Designed and operated a semi-automatic 3-camera photography rig capturing 3-5 photos per brick across the full product/color catalog to create a standardized PNG and PBR bitmap texture database.
Automated color compensation and multi-format exports with Python and Adobe Photoshop for marketing and architectural online repositories.
Co-designed the Omega Smooth Wall Kitchen Kit and co-authored its published 22-page bilingual Builders' Manual with 3D renders, layer-by-layer CAD plans, and assembly SOPs.

work.name: Improto 3D
work.summary: Led a 4-person team on a 6-month project contract to engineer, build, and commission a custom 1 m³ large-format industrial FDM 3D printer in Medellín, Colombia.
highlights: Owned mechanical CAD design and electronic/control architecture—migrating firmware from Marlin to Klipper, adding UPS power backup, filament-tension sensing, and multi-day thermal calibration.
Established the full sculpture batch production workflow and SOPs, slashing delivery lead times from 1-2 months down to 1-3 weeks across 20+ large sculptures.

work.name: Masmecanica
work.summary: Progressed from Laser Cutting Assistant to core Prototyping & Automation Engineer designing custom ISO-compliant food processing machinery.
highlights: Programmed Siemens PLCs (LOGO! and S7-1200 in TIA Portal) and integrated mechatronic systems for specialized food-processing equipment.
Engineered and thermally calibrated an automated conveyor-based herb/tea dehydration line across 10+ days of live testing to parameterize 15+ thermal recipes.
Reverse-engineered and fabricated industrial replacement components via 3D scanning, CNC, SLA 3D printing, and laser cutting.

work.name: Grupo Excala - Compañía de Empaques
work.summary: Designed electromechanical upgrades and conveyor systems within the Innovation Office for coffee and cocoa packaging machinery.
highlights: Led mechanical design and prototyping of a custom double-fold sewing attachment and base conveyor synchronization for fique sacks in the coffee industry.
Replaced high-maintenance pneumatic assemblies with reliable mechanical tensioners on legacy cone winders and spinning machines.

awards.title: 1st Place - Best SCARA Robotic Arm

publications.summary: Engineered a fault-redundant remote weather station platform and implementation guide for automated meteorological telemetry in extreme high-mountain environments.
